what: Samsara sells software and hardware for managing vehicle fleets and industrial equipment. Its dashboard cameras, sensors and platform track where vehicles are, how they are driven, and what equipment is doing.
customers: Trucking and delivery fleets, construction, utilities, local government, and field service operations.
money: connected operations platform subscriptions per vehicle or asset
moat: Once a fleet's safety programme, insurance discounts and maintenance scheduling run on its data, removing it means losing the record and the processes built on it.
risks: It still makes a small operating loss because of large stock-based compensation
Freight market weakness reduces fleet sizes and therefore subscriptions
Competition in fleet telematics is crowded
The shares trade at a very high multiple of revenue
opportunities: Revenue grew about 30% last year and about 35% a year over three years
Gross margin of 77% with strong free cash flow despite the accounting loss
Expanding beyond vehicles into equipment and site monitoring widens the market
watch: Annual recurring revenue and the number of customers above $100,000 a year.
